title: RPC Module Coupling Rule
description: Why rpc.ts restates shapes and avoids imports from the orchestrator.
body: rpc.ts mirrors src-tauri/src/apps/files.rs and restates rather than imports: an app knows its host only through @openkaava/bridge, and the day this one is extracted into a tool repository of its own, nothing in apps/files/ may be reaching into src/. A Rust test catches a drift, not pnpm build.
